what: Zions Bancorporation runs banks under local names across the American West: Zions Bank in Utah, California Bank and Trust, Amegy in Texas, Nevada State Bank and others, lending mostly to businesses.
customers: Small and mid-sized businesses across Utah, California, Texas, Arizona, Nevada and neighbouring states.
money: commercial lending funded by business deposits
treasury management, card and wealth services
moat: Business deposit relationships built over decades in fast-growing Western states, which fund the bank more cheaply than wholesale borrowing.
risks: Commercial real estate is a large share of the loan book, concentrated in the West
The 2023 regional banking crisis hit its share price hard and the memory persists
A large portfolio of long-dated securities bought at low yields still weighs on the margin
opportunities: 7.6 times earnings and 4.2 times free cash flow with $2.1B of free cash flow
A 26.6% net margin and analysts see about 17% upside, with 22 covering the stock
Its Western states keep gaining population and businesses faster than the national average
watch: Deposit costs and credit losses in commercial real estate.
